extracted.intended_audience: prospective Coursera learners interested in Wesleyan's creative writing specialization
extracted.subtask_description: Announcement and overview of Wesleyan University's Coursera specialization 'Creative Writing: The Craft of Story', describing its component courses, assessment format, and credentialing/prize outcomes. Intended for people considering taking the online specialization or learning how it is structured.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Craft of Plot
rubrics_metrics.description: Course in the specialization titled 'The Craft of Plot'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Taught by Brando Skyhorse; part of the four-course specialization that prepares learners for the capstone. Course work will be evaluated and given feedback through an online peer review system using an instructor-provided rubric.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Craft of Setting and Description
rubrics_metrics.description: Course in the specialization titled 'The Craft of Setting and Description'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Taught by Amity Gaige; part of the specialization sequence. Assignments will be part of the peer-review evaluation structure with rubrics provided by instructors.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Craft of Character
rubrics_metrics.description: Course in the specialization titled 'The Craft of Character'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Taught by Amy Bloom; focuses on character as a core dimension of craft. Course includes assignments assessed via the program's online peer review process and instructor rubrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Craft of Style
rubrics_metrics.description: Course in the specialization titled 'The Craft of Style'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Taught by Salvatore Scibona; addresses stylistic elements of writing. Like the other courses, learner work will receive peer feedback guided by an instructor-provided rubric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crafting Your Story (Capstone)
rubrics_metrics.description: Capstone course titled 'Crafting Your Story' that concludes the specialization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Taught by Salvatore Scibona. Passing all assignments in the specialization unlocks the capstone; the capstone grants a certificate of completion. Note: the capstone lecture viewing may not be free; assignments/peer review access may require payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructor-provided peer-review rubric
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructors will provide a clear rubric for students to assess each other's success in achieving the goals of an assignment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learner writing will be evaluated and given feedback through an online peer review system. The announcement emphasizes that instructors will make rubrics available so peers can assess achievement of assignment goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Passing assignments to unlock capstone and certificate
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that learners pass all assignments to unlock the capstone course and obtain a certificate of completion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learners may view most lectures for free, but must pay to access assignments and peer review aspects; only by passing assignments (the paid components) do learners unlock the capstone and certificate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Top-performing student selection for conference prize
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognition/prize for top-performing learners in the specialization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Three of the top-performing students in the specialization will receive free tuition, room and board to the Wesleyan Writer’s Conference. The announcement indicates selection is based on performance across the specialization, though specific selection criteria are not detailed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access model and credential/payment details
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy about access to course content and paid features relevant to assessment and certification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learners may view lectures in each MOOC for free (except possibly the capstone), but must pay to access assignments and peer review. Passing assignments (the paid components) is required to unlock the capstone and the certificate of completion.
